conclusion: Across the executed seeds 7, 19, and 31 and metrics mse, mae, and median_absolute_error, OLS shows lower test error than the matched training-mean predictor under 10% test-label outliers of magnitude 10 with clean training data. The direction is consistent across all nine seed-metric cells, with OLS mse near 10.16-10.27 versus baseline mse near 19.71-23.95, and OLS mae/median_absolute_error roughly 1.25-1.28 and 0.21-0.28 versus baseline roughly 3.57-3.87 and 3.04-3.53. This is a bounded report on this specific configuration only; no general scientific value is claimed.
limitations: Only seeds 7, 19, and 31 were executed; seed-to-seed variability is characterized by three points only.
Only the magnitude-10, 10% outlier configuration was tested; no sensitivity analysis over outlier magnitude or fraction exists.
The baseline is a matched training-mean predictor; results do not speak to other baselines or to robustness of OLS itself.
No independent verification was performed; verification_refs is empty and no verify call was made.
No claim of general scientific value is made.
